recap: Week 1 kicked off with a statement win from the Gridiron Gladiators, who cruised past the Touchdown Titans 128.4 to 110.2 behind a balanced scoring effort. In the other matchup, the Blitz Brigade edged out the End Zone Enforcers in a tighter 101.8-95.6 contest.
trends: The Gladiators looked deep and well-rounded out of the gate, while the Enforcers' bench depth will be one to watch after a slow start. The Titans put up a respectable score in a loss, suggesting they're competitive even against strong opponents.
